The reader was shown to see a failure known to be present before that zero was reported: it returns the two ids negative-control.log reports FAILED, and on synthesised pairs an added id gives count 1, a green pair 0 and a one-sided pair None. findings.text: the file this change creates ends without a trailing newline, so it is the one new lint finding (W292) and the one new ruff-format failure at the reviewed head: with the repository's own configuration the three touched source and test paths report 7 findings at bd231eff and 8 at fafbbe1f, and `ruff format --check` reports 2 files to reformat at base against 3 at head, which the repository's stated rule that a commit adds no finding on its staged paths forbids; the fix is one appended newline (reproduce: `ruff check --no-cache --config <repo>/pyproject.toml` and `ruff format --check` on that path at fafbbe1f, log ruff-delta.log).

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against bd231eff — ee6fb313 adds `_released_follower_warning` and `_watcher_delivery_admission`, wires the launching path at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:4365 and the validating path at :3435, adds `released`/`session_follower_released` to reckon/crew/runs.py, and adds the four-case test file; fafbbe1f appends the section landing record, the cumulative evidence entry and one figure, with `grep -c '^-[^-]'` over the evidence page at fafbbe1f returning 0 deletions.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names the released case proceeding with the attach command in its warning and the never-registered case refused, each through a real dispatch and through plan_dispatch; tests/test_expired_follower_keeps_dispatching.py:133 and :170 assert the pair through `dispatch` with a genuinely running registered watcher process, :200 and :227 the same pair through `plan_dispatch`, the manifest records the gate at fafbbe1f as 6 passed exit 0, and my own re-run at the reviewed head reproduced 6 passed EXIT=0; the one caveat is that "a dry run" is satisfied at the plan_dispatch level the done-when names, not through `reckon crew dispatch --dry-run`, whose call site forwards neither session nor watch_required.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a session whose follower expired keeps dispatching with a re-arm warning, and the landed change is exactly that split — reckon/crew/runs.py:2143 reports `released` only where a registration file survives with a free advisory lock, reckon/crew/dispatch.py:985 `_watcher_delivery_admission` admits that case while refusing the never-registered one, and reckon/crew/dispatch.py:970 puts the paste-ready attach command in the warning text.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate command, its log paths, the module and cwd of the scratch base-arm run, the reason cli.py was left to its owning node, the pre-existing follow-session failure reproduced identically at base bd231eff in a scratch tree, and a declared negative control whose log's first line repeats the mutation verbatim.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven paths and `git diff --name-only bd231eff..fafbbe1f` names six, every one inside the declaration, with the declared tests/test_crew_dispatch_watcher_required.py left untouched as it was already green.

justifications.durability: reinstating the regression twice reddens exactly the two released cases and no others — the node's own mutation at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1010 (negative-control.log, 2 failed) and mine on the flag at reckon/crew/runs.py:2298 (mutation-control-released-flag.log, 2 failed / 2 passed) — so the two cases that carry the clause each have an assertion that fires.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded with revision, command, module and cwd and reproduced here at 6 passed EXIT=0, but the expected attach line the assertion compares against is produced by the same function the warning text came from (reckon/crew/runs.py:2161 `_watch_attach_line`), so a defect there would keep both sides green.
justifications.fit: the names are mechanism-named and the two helpers sit beside the watcher code they serve, but the file the change adds ends without a trailing newline at tests/test_expired_follower_keeps_dispatching.py:248 and is the single new lint finding and format failure the reviewed head carries.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1010 refuses only a session with no registration to release, so a released session proceeds while the never-registered one is still refused, which is the section's deliverable, though the dry-run half stays unreachable from the command at reckon/cli.py:1425.
justifications.scope_discipline: all six paths in the diff are inside the declared write paths and the concurrent node's reckon/cli.py was left alone rather than edited outside the fence.
